defects.description: Tenant membership is checked with startsWith, so a user of tenant acme reaches every tenant whose slug begins with acme, such as acme-corp.
defects.why_missed: The suite compares tenants that are either identical or share no prefix; prefix collisions are a property of the tenant namespace, not a branch of the function.
defects.severity_rationale: An ordinary user can cross into a neighboring tenant under the default configuration.

detection_criteria.mechanism: Tenant membership is checked with startsWith, so a user of tenant acme reaches every tenant whose slug begins with acme, such as acme-corp.
detection_criteria.proof: Show an exploitable condition, or a concrete violation of a named security property (the input and the boundary it crosses).

defects.description: includes on a comma-separated roles string is a substring test, so any role containing the letters admin grants admin.
defects.why_missed: The legacy-string test uses roles that are either exactly admin or unrelated words, so the one shared line behaves like the array version on every suite input.
defects.severity_rationale: A role containing admin can receive administrative access during ordinary checks under the default configuration.

detection_criteria.mechanism: includes on a comma-separated roles string is a substring test, so any role containing the letters admin grants admin.
